source_contract.observed_requirement: WP807 CapabilityEvidence is only a receipt-bound measurement candidate. A supported report requires independently verified upstream reconciliation/receipt content that actually attests the declared shared fixture-family identity plus compatible baseline/intervention measurements for all four capability families.

observed_measurement_gap: The exact accepted receipts above are component-CI acceptance receipts, not four compatible WP807 capability-measurement records.
None of the four exact accepted receipts attests a WP807 shared_fixture_family_sha256 common to all capability families.
The receipts do not supply the complete matched WP807 baseline_score_ppm, intervention_score_ppm, sample_count, success_count and action_count measurement tuple for all four capabilities.
Therefore constructing CapabilityEvidence values that reach SUPPORTED_AT_COMPONENT_SCOPE would require caller-invented semantic provenance or measurements and is forbidden.
decision: Do not synthesize capability scores or family digests. Keep WP807 generation 1 ACTIVE and current verdict NOT_EVALUABLE until real compatible measurement evidence exists and its shared family provenance can be independently verified against exact upstream receipt/reconciliation content.
next_exact_action: Create or admit a real held-out measurement-production contract that emits semantically attested shared fixture-family identity and matched capability metrics from the four accepted benchmark families without leaking evaluator-only state into SUT input. Bind those measurements to the exact upstream reconciliation/receipt identities; only then evaluate WP807. If such measurements cannot be produced under current evidence boundaries, retain NOT_EVALUABLE rather than substituting CI success for capability evidence.
